caption: The video showcases an angled overhead view of a large tabletop domino and marble-run construction assembled on a light wooden surface. The upper-left area holds a sprawling pile of loose teal, blue, purple and white dominoes, interspersed with a few standing stacks and arrow-shaped arrangements that point across the table. A tall diagonal wall of wooden dominoes, colored in bands of red, orange, black and white, runs across the middle-right of the frame. It separates the loose field from the structured track below. On the left stands a small blue tower topped by two red funnel bowls beside white rectangular blocks, while a U-shaped wooden track curves through the foreground. To its right lie two long flat wooden ramp strips, one ending in a yellow triangular stop and the other in a yellow arrow tip. A black camera on a tripod occupies the right edge, and the watermark '@HEVESH5' sits at bottom-left. Throughout the excerpt every element remains fixed in identical positions. The framing is constant and the lighting unchanged, capturing the assembled machine at rest.
